name: @loom/a2ui-egress
description: Projects a Loom agent surface onto the Google A2UI (Agent-to-UI) wire protocol v1.0 via @loom/plugin-a2ui — the canonical showcase of the A2UISurfaceBridge egress adapter: fold SURFACE_PATCH deltas into absolute createSurface/updateDataModel messages, and drive a human-approval gate through an inbound A2UI action. Headless.
